findings.source_quote: “(tongues, psalms and hymns and spiritual songs)” presents two choices: “tongues” or the grouped phrase “psalms and hymns and spiritual songs.”
findings.suggested_fix: Make the two options explicit, for example: “(bahasa roh, atau mazmur, puji-pujian, dan nyanyian rohani).”
findings.translation_quote: “(bahasa roh, mazmur, puji-pujian, dan nyanyian rohani)” can be read as four separate options rather than two choices, with the final three grouped together.
